item.title: 0.1.5 Beta 2
item.description:
# SakuraCord v0.1.5-Beta-2
SakuraCord v0.1.5 Beta 2 fixes update labeling and makes moving between Nightly and Regular release tracks clearer.
## Update labels
- Fixed Sparkle prompts so nightly updates show full beta names such as `0.1.5 Beta 2`.
## Release tracks
- Changed Nightly-to-Regular switching to offer the latest Regular release directly instead of reporting the newer Nightly build as up to date. - Added clear guidance when installing the Regular release requires a manual replacement because Sparkle blocks downgrades.
## Release announcements
- Removed duplicate moon emoji from generated nightly announcement titles so the emoji appears only in the main headline.
**Full Changelog:** [v0.1.5-Beta-1...v0.1.5-Beta-2](https://github.com/SakuraCordApp/SakuraCord/compare/v0.1.5-Beta-1...v0.1.5-Beta-2)
